title: What the Go and Python SDKs do for ZIA SCIM

prose.text: Use this when a script built on the SDK behaves differently from the REST behavior in [[zia.scim.operations]]. These claims are about the client, not the service.

go-surface.statement: The Go SDK has a ZIA SCIM client with get, get by name, create (POST), update (PUT), delete and list-all functions for users, and the matching functions for groups.

quotes: resp, err := service.Client.DoRequest(ctx, http.MethodPut, relativeURL, scimUser, nil)

go-no-patch-bulk.statement: The Go SCIM client has no PATCH or Bulk call, so partial updates and bulk modification against ZIA need direct HTTP.
go-no-patch-bulk.conditions: Search run: `git -C vendor/zscaler-sdk-go grep -n -i "patch\|bulk" HEAD -- zscaler/zia/services/scim_api` returned nothing.

python-none.statement: The Python SDK has no ZIA SCIM client; the only SCIM mention under its ZIA package is the directory_sync_migrate_to_scim_enabled authentication-settings field.
python-none.conditions: Search run: `grep -rli scim vendor/zscaler-sdk-python/zscaler/zia` returned only authentication_settings.py and models/authentication_settings.py (v1.10.0 pin).

quotes: Enables migration to SCIM by disabling legacy sync.

user-struct.statement: The Go SCIMUser struct carries schemas, id, userName, displayName, the enterprise extension (department) and meta. It has no groups, active, externalId, emails or name fields.

cannot-send-active.statement: Because SCIMUser has no active, groups or externalId field, a create or update through the Go SDK cannot disable a user or set group membership from the user side or an external ID; membership can be set only through the group's members list.
cannot-send-active.conditions: Client-side only: derived from the struct and the omitempty request body; a caller could still reach the endpoint with their own HTTP.

getall-users-type.statement: GetAllUsers returns []SCIMGroup, not users, so a user list read through it is decoded into the group struct and loses userName and the department extension.

byname-display.statement: GetUserByName and GetGroupByName take a displayName and match it case-insensitively against the display name through a search, returning the first match; GetUserByName does not match userName.

quotes: func GetUserByName(ctx context.Context, service *zscaler.ScimZIAService, displayName string)

go-paging.statement: List-all and by-name calls use POST /Users/.search or /Groups/.search with a page size capped at 100, advance startIndex by the requested page size rather than the number returned, and stop when startIndex plus the page size exceeds totalResults or a page is empty.

go-paging-estimate.statement: Because the server's totalResults is only an estimate above 10K until the last page, the SDK's stop condition can end a large list early or run past the end, and the 100-per-page search path differs from the 1,000-per-page REST GET.
go-paging-estimate.conditions: Derived from the helper's stop rule and the documented estimate; the direction and size of the estimate error are not documented, and the ZPA helper has the same shape (see the shared list-pagination subject).

go-client-config.statement: The ZIA SCIM client is separate from the OneAPI client: it takes ZIA_SCIM_API_TOKEN and ZIA_SCIM_TENANT_ID (plus a cloud), builds https://scim.<cloud>.net/<tenant ID>/scim, and sends the token as a Bearer header with content type application/scim+json.

no-limiter.statement: NewZIAScimService leaves the client's RateLimiter nil, and the SCIM client throttles only if one is set, so SDK loops are not paced to the server's 5 requests per second.
no-limiter.conditions: Client-side: the construction leaves the limiter nil and DoRequest waits only when it is non-nil; the server limit comes from the help article.

scim-base-url.summary: The SDK builds a SCIM base URL without the IdP ID that the help's base URL carries.

positions.says: The base URL is scim.<cloud>/<Organization ID>/<IdP ID>/scim.
The SDK uses scim.<cloud>.net/<tenant ID>/scim, with no IdP ID.

scim-base-url.impact: Whether the SDK URL reaches the same server as an IdP-specific URL, and whether the tenant ID equals the Organization ID, is not shown by either source; test against the tenant before relying on the SDK's URL.
